messages.text: Hey Ghanisht, looks like we are stuck in this lecture together again. How are you holding up?

messages.speaker: Anubhav Prasad
messages.text: Hey Ghanisht, good to see you. How was that AI Fundamentals lecture this morning? You look like you're already deep in thought.

messages.speaker: Ghanisht Kaushal
messages.text: Hey Anubhav! It was pretty intense, honestly. We dove into some complex optimization techniques that I'm still trying to wrap my head around. How about your EE lecture? Still grinding on those circuit designs?

messages.speaker: Anubhav Prasad
messages.text: Definitely. I've got a busy afternoon ahead at the SAB—need to draft some schematics and run simulations. It's tough, but I'm trying to figure out how to bridge these hardware circuits with some AI models I've been reading about.

messages.speaker: Ghanisht Kaushal
messages.text: That sounds like a killer combination. If you need a hand with the algorithmic side or some performance validation, just let me know. I'll be at the utility block for some CP practice later, but I'm always down to talk tech.

messages.speaker: Anubhav Prasad
messages.text: I'll take you up on that. Good luck with your training and the CP practice today. Catch you later for dinner?

messages.speaker: Ghanisht Kaushal
messages.text: For sure, let's meet at the mess around 7:30. See you then!
